This Master Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of the Effective Date by and between Northwind Analytics Holdings Ltd. ("Client") and Meridian Grove Consulting Pte. Ltd. ("Supplier"). Client and Supplier are each a "Party" and together the "Parties".

Page 1 of 6

## 1. Structure and Scope

1.1 This Agreement sets out the general terms governing all professional services ordered by Client from Supplier.
1.2 Specific services shall be described in individually executed statements of work ("SOW"), each of which incorporates this Agreement by reference. Exhibit A sets out the SOW template.
1.3 In the event of a conflict between this Agreement and an executed SOW, this Agreement shall prevail, except where the SOW expressly identifies the clause of this Agreement it is intended to override.
1.4 This Agreement does not commit Client to purchase any minimum volume or value of services.

## 2. Term and Renewal

2.1 The initial term of this Agreement is twenty-four (24) months commencing on the Effective Date (the "Initial Term").
2.2 Upon expiry of the Initial Term, this Agreement shall automatically renew for successive twelve (12) month periods (each a "Renewal Term") unless either Party gives written notice of non-renewal no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of the then-current term.
2.3 Supplier may increase its rates with effect from the commencement of any Renewal Term by giving written notice not less than thirty (30) days before the end of the then-current term, provided that any such increase shall not exceed seven percent (7%) of the then-current rates.

Page 2 of 6

## 3. Charges, Invoicing and Payment

3.1 Charges shall be calculated on the basis of the rate card set out in Exhibit B, or on the fixed-fee basis stated in the applicable SOW.
3.2 Supplier shall invoice Client monthly in arrears. Each invoice shall itemise the personnel, hours and deliverables to which it relates.
3.3 Client shall pay each undisputed invoice within forty-five (45) days of receipt.
3.4 Client may withhold payment of any amount it disputes in good faith, provided that Client notifies Supplier of the disputed amount within fifteen (15) days of receipt of the relevant invoice and pays all undisputed amounts when due.
3.5 All charges are exclusive of goods and services tax, which shall be added where applicable.

## 4. Supplier Personnel and Subcontracting

4.1 Supplier shall assign personnel with the skills and experience reasonably required to perform the services.
4.2 Supplier shall not subcontract any part of the services without Client's prior written consent, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld.
4.3 Supplier remains fully liable to Client for the acts and omissions of any approved subcontractor as if they were the acts and omissions of Supplier.
4.4 Supplier shall give Client not less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice of any proposed replacement of key personnel identified in a SOW, and any replacement shall be of equivalent or superior experience.
4.5 Supplier shall notify Client at least thirty (30) days in advance of any change to the location from which the services are delivered, to the subprocessors handling Client data, or to any material tooling used to deliver the services. Client may object in writing within fifteen (15) days of such notice, and no such change shall be implemented over Client's written objection.

Page 3 of 6

## 5. Intellectual Property

5.1 All deliverables created by Supplier specifically for Client under a SOW ("Deliverables") shall vest in Client upon full payment of the charges relating to such Deliverables.
5.2 Supplier retains ownership of any pre-existing materials, tools, methodologies and know-how used in performing the services ("Supplier Background IP"), and grants Client a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to use Supplier Background IP to the extent embedded in the Deliverables.
5.3 Supplier warrants that the Deliverables shall not infringe the intellectual property rights of any third party, and shall indemnify Client against any claim to the contrary.

## 6. Confidentiality

6.1 Each Party shall keep confidential all Confidential Information of the other Party and shall not disclose it to any third party without prior written consent.
6.2 The obligations in this clause 6 shall survive for three (3) years following expiry or termination of this Agreement.
6.3 Disclosure required by law or by a competent regulator shall not constitute a breach of this clause, provided the disclosing Party gives prior notice where lawfully permitted.

## 7. Data Protection and Data Return

7.1 Each Party shall comply with applicable data protection laws in respect of personal data processed under this Agreement.
7.2 Supplier shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect Client data against unauthorised access, loss or alteration.
7.3 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement, Supplier shall, at Client's written request made within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination, return Client data in a commonly used machine-readable format. Where no such request is made within that thirty (30) day period, Supplier shall securely delete all Client data.
7.4 Supplier may charge its then-current professional rates for any data return exercise exceeding eight (8) hours of effort.

Page 4 of 6

## 8. Warranties and Remedies

8.1 Supplier warrants that the services shall be performed with reasonable skill and care and in accordance with the applicable SOW.
8.2 If Supplier breaches the warranty in clause 8.1, Client shall notify Supplier in writing describing the breach in reasonable detail. Supplier shall have thirty (30) days from receipt of such notice to remedy the breach at no additional charge (the "Cure Period").
8.3 If Supplier fails to remedy the breach within the Cure Period, Client may (i) terminate the affected SOW with immediate effect and (ii) recover the charges paid for the defective services.
8.4 If Client fails to pay any undisputed invoice when due, Supplier shall give written notice and Client shall have a Cure Period of thirty (30) days. Following expiry of that Cure Period without payment, Supplier may suspend the affected services and charge interest at two percent (2%) per annum above the prevailing three-month SORA rate.

## 9. Limitation of Liability

9.1 Neither Party excludes or limits its liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, for fraud, or for any other liability that cannot lawfully be excluded.
9.2 Subject to clause 9.1, the total aggregate liability of either Party arising out of or in connection with this Agreement, whether in contract, tort (including negligence) or otherwise, shall not exceed the total charges actually paid by Client under the affected SOW during the three (3) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
9.3 Neither Party shall be liable for any indirect, consequential, special or punitive loss, loss of profit, loss of revenue, loss of anticipated savings, or loss of goodwill.
9.4 The limits in clause 9.2 shall not apply to Supplier's indemnity obligations under clause 5.3 or to either Party's breach of clause 6.

Page 5 of 6

## 10. Termination

10.1 Either Party may terminate this Agreement or any SOW for convenience by giving sixty (60) days' prior written notice to the other Party. Upon such termination Client shall pay for all services properly performed up to the effective date of termination.
10.2 Either Party may terminate this Agreement immediately by written notice if the other Party (i) commits a material breach that is not remedied within the applicable Cure Period, or (ii) becomes insolvent, enters liquidation, or has a receiver appointed over any of its assets.
10.3 Termination of this Agreement shall automatically terminate all SOWs then in force.
10.4 Clauses 5, 6, 7, 9, 11 and 12 shall survive termination of this Agreement.

## 11. Force Majeure

11.1 Neither Party shall be liable for any failure or delay in performance to the extent caused by an event beyond its reasonable control, including acts of God, flood, earthquake, war, terrorism, epidemic, governmental action, or failure of public telecommunications networks ("Force Majeure Event").
11.2 The affected Party shall notify the other Party in writing within five (5) business days of the Force Majeure Event and shall use reasonable endeavours to mitigate its effects.
11.3 If a Force Majeure Event continues for more than sixty (60) consecutive days, either Party may terminate this Agreement by written notice without liability.

## 12. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution

12.1 This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of Singapore.
12.2 Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall first be escalated to the Parties' respective senior executives for good-faith resolution within thirty (30) days.
12.3 Failing such resolution, the dispute shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration administered by the Singapore International Arbitration Centre in accordance with its Arbitration Rules in force at the time. The seat of arbitration shall be Singapore, the tribunal shall consist of one arbitrator, and the language of the arbitration shall be English.

## 13. General

13.1 This Agreement, together with its Exhibits and all executed SOWs, constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties and supersedes all prior discussions.
13.2 No amendment to this Agreement shall be effective unless made in writing and signed by an authorised representative of each Party.
13.3 Neither Party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other Party, save to an affiliate or in connection with a merger or sale of substantially all assets.
13.4 Nothing in this Agreement creates a partnership, joint venture or employment relationship between the Parties.
13.5 The Exhibits to this Agreement are:
    Exhibit A — Statement of Work Template
    Exhibit B — Rate Card (effective 1 January 2026)
    Exhibit C — Information Security Requirements
